title: Desktop, taskbar & Finder
blurb: Icons, taskbar, Dock, notifications, screenshots, windows.

remedies.title: Use several desktops (or my windows vanished to another desktop)
remedies.why: Extra desktops keep windows apart; a window can end up on another one.

steps.text: Windows+Tab shows all desktops; Ctrl+Windows+Left/Right switches.
Mission Control (F3 or three-finger swipe up) shows Spaces; Control+Left/Right switches.

remedies.title: Pin apps to the taskbar, Start or Dock
remedies.why: Pinned apps are one click away.

steps.text: Right-click an app in Start (or a running app in the taskbar) › Pin to taskbar / Pin to Start.
Right-click a running app in the Dock › Options › Keep in Dock, or drag it from Applications.

remedies.title: Change the wallpaper, theme or dark mode

steps.text: Settings › Personalization › Background and Colors (Choose your mode: Dark/Light).
System Settings › Wallpaper; Appearance for Dark/Light.

remedies.escalate: Work devices may lock the wallpaper.

remedies.title: Finder is missing items in the sidebar (Desktop, Documents, iCloud)
remedies.why: Sidebar items can be hidden in Finder's settings.

steps.text: Finder › Settings › Sidebar: tick what you want to see.
Drag any folder into the sidebar to add it.

remedies.title: File Explorer is slow or keeps "Working on it…"
remedies.why: Thumbnails for big folders, a disconnected network drive, or Quick Access history.

steps.text: Disconnect network drives you don't reach any more.
Folder options › General › Clear File Explorer history.
For a slow folder: right-click it › Properties › Customize › Optimize for: General items.

remedies.title: Where did the full right-click menu go?
remedies.why: Windows 11 shows a short menu first; the full one is one step away.

steps.text: Click "Show more options" or press Shift+F10 (or Shift+right-click) for the full menu.

remedies.title: Turn on Do Not Disturb or Focus while working
remedies.why: Focus modes hold notifications while you concentrate or present.

steps.text: Notifications › Do not disturb; Clock app › Focus sessions for timed focus.
Control Center › Focus, or System Settings › Focus for schedules.
Both turn on automatically when you share your screen (if enabled).

remedies.title: Record my screen
remedies.why: Both systems have built-in screen recorders.

steps.text: Snipping Tool › Record (Windows+Shift+R on recent Windows 11), or Xbox Game Bar (Windows+Alt+R) for one app.
⌘+Shift+5 › Record Entire Screen or Selected Portion.
Teams and Zoom can also record meetings.
